{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id rows, keeping the highest sample_seq for each
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the result
print("After deduplication, shape:", trial_df.shape)

# Verify the 'responded' column exists
print("Column names:", trial_df.columns.tolist())

# Check the values in 'responded'
print("Values in 'responded':", trial_df['responded'].unique())"}
